paceNote: These are Denver paces. At sea level in Huntington Beach the same effort runs about 10–15 sec/mi faster, so 8:05–8:15 MP here equals 3:30 pace on race day. On easy days go by effort, not pace: if you wear a heart rate monitor, stay under about 75% of max. Strides are 20-second pickups at a fast, relaxed effort.

weeks.note: Mileage has been 6–9 a week. This week just gets you moving again.
Thanksgiving Thursday: a turkey trot is fine, just run it easy.

tue: 3 × 1 mi at tempo, 1 min jog between

weeks.note: First marathon-pace work. It should feel controlled.

weeks.note: Lighter week so the first block sinks in.
From here on, Friday runs count. They keep the long run from carrying too much of the week. Fuel on every long run of 13+.
fri: Christmas: move it to Thu or Sun if needed
sat: Easy pace. Practice fueling: a gel every 30–40 min.

tue: 6 × 800 m at interval pace, 2 min jog

sat: Easy, last 3 at MP. Wear your race shoes.

weeks.checkpoint: Checkpoint Saturday: if 6 mi at MP after 3 easy miles feels controlled, race for 3:30. If it's a grind, race for the 3:40 baseline.
sat: 6 mi at MP in the middle. Checkpoint run.

weeks.note: Rehearse race morning: breakfast, shoes, kit, fueling.

weeks.note: Mileage drops. Keep classes light on legs.
